nodes.label: ADR 0028: Tenant Notes as Soft-State, Append-Only Audit
nodes.rationale: Dedicated tenant_notes table (id, organization_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, author_user_id text, body, is_pinned, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Partial indexes on (org, created_at DESC) and (org, is_pinned, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. Edit window: 1 hour by note author, then frozen; super_admin can soft-delete any time. Every create/update/delete writes platform-admin audit log row. 1h edit window relies on server clock (UTC, no client-clock injection risk).
alternatives_rejected: Per-org jsonb array (not indexable, no per-row audit, no soft delete, volume bloat)
Unlimited edit audit-log-everything (noisy or fragile on debounced UPDATEs)
Per-note edit history table (overkill for 1h window)

nodes.label: tenant_notes table (1h edit window, soft-delete, audit)
